channel.title: Office Software Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: Slasify Review (2026): EOR From $250, Contractors From $50
item.description: Slasify: Three services, each with a starting price and a custom quote. Only starting prices are public.

item.title: Sucuri Review (2026): Website Firewall and Cleanup, From $229/yr
item.description: Sucuri sells per website. Pricing is per site, so costs climb quickly for agencies, and plans for 10 or more sites have no published price.

item.title: NexGen Virtual Office Review (2026): Hybrid Teams, $15-$25 a User
item.description: NexGen Virtual Office: Enterprise customers, which the page describes as 1,000 or more seats, have to book a demo. We found no current free trial.

item.title: pCloud Review (2026): Lifetime Cloud Storage From €219 Once
item.description: pCloud: Premium 500 GB is €219 (struck through from €279). Client-side encryption is not included in personal plans; it is a separate €150 purchase.

item.title: Recruit CRM Review (2026): Agency ATS and CRM, From €79 a User
item.description: Recruit CRM: Pro is €79 per user a month billed annually or €95 monthly, with 100 credits per user a month. The headline seat price is not the whole bill.

item.title: Netart Review (2026): CloudHosting, $18.75 Promo First Term
item.description: Netart sells a broad range of cloud services. The headline offers are first-period promotions; after them you pay the standard $18.75, $37.50 or $75 a month.

item.title: PDF Agile Review (2026): One-Time Plans, Lifetime at $119
item.description: PDF Agile: The free version limits conversion to 2 pages and 5 tasks. The Semi-Annual and Annual plans are one-time payments tied to an upgrade period.

item.title: Liltio Review (2026): Local Mac Dictation, $49 Once
item.description: Liltio: $49 standard price, with no recurring subscription. Speech recognition is local, but if you switch on a configured remote AI for text transforms.

item.title: WordPerfect Office Review (2026): One-Time Licence, Windows Only
item.description: WordPerfect Office: On 22 October 2026 the full version download was $99.99 for Home & Student, $249.99 for Standard and $399.99 for Professional.

item.title: EasyBrise Review (2026): $295 US Company Setup, State Fee Extra
item.description: EasyBrise: Global Launch is $295 one-time plus the state fee, listed as $104 for Wyoming and $143 for Delaware. Refunds stop once documents go to the state.

item.title: eBillity Review (2026): Time Tracking From $8 per User
item.description: EBillity sells four plans per user, and the pricing page says annual billing saves 20%. Workforce and Premium add a base fee on top of the per-user price.

item.title: Signable Review (2026): UK E-Signatures, Priced per Envelope
item.description: Signable prices by the envelope, not by the user. Business and Enterprise prices are only 'from' figures and go through sales.

item.title: Bizee Review (2026): $0 LLC Formation, Plus the State Fee
item.description: Bizee: Basic $0, Standard $199 and Premium $299. The $0 headline leaves out the state filing fee, which is usually the larger part of the bill.

item.title: Your Company Formations Review (2026): UK Company From £2.48
item.description: Your Company Formations: One-off packages for forming a UK limited company, each plus the £100 Companies House incorporation fee, which is added separately.

item.title: VideoScribe Review (2026): Whiteboard Animation From €13.75
item.description: VideoScribe: Lite is €34.00 a month billed monthly, or €13.75 a month billed annually at €165.00. Payments are non-refundable according to the help centre.

item.title: UserHelp.co Review (2026): Website Feedback Widget, $59 One-Time
item.description: UserHelp.co — Basic is free forever: unlimited responses, one project, categories. Basic is limited to one project and shows a watermark.

item.title: Imagify Review (2026): WordPress Image Compression From $4.99
item.description: Imagify: Growth is $4.99 a month billed yearly, or $5.99 billed monthly. A prepaid yearly plan is not refunded.

item.title: ShortlistIQ Review (2026): AI Interviewer From $49 a Month
item.description: ShortlistIQ: Every account starts on a free plan for up to 10 applicants, with no credit card.

item.title: Pdfdodo Review (2026): PDF to Excel From $25 a Month, 300 Pages
item.description: Pdfdodo: Free $0 for 25 pages a month and 5 MB per PDF. The yearly Solo card shows $20 a month beside $200 billed yearly, which cannot both be right.

item.title: Inbox Zero Review (2026): Open-Source AI Email Assistant From $18
item.description: Inbox Zero: Starter is $18 per user a month billed annually or $20 monthly. Pricing is per user, and a second mailbox needs Plus.

item.title: Deftform Review (2026): €4 per Form, €25 a Month or €189 Once
item.description: Deftform: Lifetime is €189 one-time for unlimited forms, or €16 a month for 12 months as an instalment plan. The pricing is easy to misread.

item.title: xTiles Review (2026): Free Plan, Plus From $12.42/mo Yearly
item.description: xTiles: Plus is $19 a month, or $12.42 a month billed yearly, which the page says saves $79 a year. Pro's headline is AI control of your workspace.

item.title: DigiParser Review (2026): From $49/mo, Billed per Page
item.description: DigiParser: Starter is $69 a month billed monthly, or $49 a month billed yearly ($588 a year). Billing is per page, not per document.

item.title: WPLP Review (2026): Priced by Site Count, Not Pageviews
item.description: WPLP: The cookie plugin's own listing says the free version already includes the cookie banner.

item.title: HostPapa Review (2026): $2.95 Intro, Renews From $8.99
item.description: HostPapa: Growth renews at $17.99, $15.99, $14.99 or $13.99. The $2.95 is a first-term price on a 3-year term for new customers only.

item.title: Shopmonkey Review (2026): $215-$449/mo, Payment Fees Unlisted
item.description: Shopmonkey — Billed annually, which the page says saves up to 10%: Basic $215 a month, Clever $359, Genius $449. Card processing is part of the product.

item.title: Samsara Review (2026): Seven Plans, Not One Price
item.description: Samsara: The Pricing and Plans page names seven packages. The pricing page asks how many vehicles you run and leads to a sales form.

item.title: Wondershare PDFelement Review (2026): $79.99/yr or $129.99 Once
item.description: Wondershare PDFelement: The 2-Year Plan is US$109.99 (list US$149) and renews manually. A perpetual licence covers PDFelement 13, not later major versions.

item.title: CO2 Impact Review (2026): UK Carbon Reporting From £468 a Year
item.description: CO2 Impact: Basic is £468 a year (£39.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 operational site. Every licence is a 12-month commitment.

item.title: NordPass Review (2026): €3.99 a Seat, Teams Only in 10-Packs
item.description: NordPass: The Free plan has autosave, autofill and secure storage. Teams is sold only as a 10-user pack and Business and Enterprise have a 5-user minimum.
